item.title: Evaluating RAG and LLM Applications
item.description:
Simple definition#

Evaluation is measuring how well your AI system does its job, on a fixed set of test cases, with repeatable scores. For RAG you measure two things separately: did we find the right information (retrieval), and did we use it correctly (generation)?

item.title: Agent Reliability, Guardrails and Evaluation
item.description:
Simple definition#

Agent reliability is the engineering that makes an agent do the right thing consistently, stop when it should, and fail safely when it cannot succeed. It combines guardrails (prevent bad actions), budgets (bound cost and time), evaluation (measure behaviour before and after release) and observability (see what happened).
